<p style="font: 10pt / 1.2 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font: 10pt / 1.2 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><b><i>General Business Development</i></b></span></p>
<p style="font: 10pt / 1.2 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0px; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">We operate in the fragrance business, and manufacture, market and distribute a wide array of prestige fragrances and fragrance related products. We manage our business in <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_022KRKPDKW00000000000000000000fs">two</span> segments, European based operations and United States based operations. Certain prestige fragrance products are produced and marketed by our European based operations through our <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_LX1J8E7LC000000000000000000000fs">72</span>% owned subsidiary in Paris, Interparfums SA, which is also a publicly traded company as <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_ZFIC3LTGOG00000000000000000000fs">28</span>% of Interparfums SA shares trade on the Euronext.</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">Our business is not capital intensive, and it is important to note that we do not own manufacturing facilities. We act as a general contractor and source our needed components from our suppliers. These components are either received and stored directly at our third party fillers or received at <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_NYLIZTENKW00000000000000000000fs">one</span> of our distribution centers and then, based upon production needs, the components are sent to <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_TW44D0RAPS00000000000000000000fs">one</span> of several third party fillers, which manufacture the finished products for us and then deliver them to <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_XTWZO7WSZK00000000000000000000fs">one</span> of our distribution centers.</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">Our fragrance products focus on prestige brands, each with a devoted following. By focusing on&#160;markets where the brands are best known, we have had many successful product launches. We typically launch new fragrance families for our brands every few years ("blockbusters"), and more frequently introduce seasonal and limited edition fragrances ("flankers" or "line extensions").</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">The creation and marketing of each product family are intimately linked with the brand&#8217;s name, its past and present positioning, customer base and, more generally, the prevailing market atmosphere. Accordingly, we generally study the market for each proposed family of fragrance products for almost a full year before we introduce any new product into the market. This study is intended to define the general position of the fragrance family and more particularly its scent, bottle, packaging and appeal to the buyer. In our opinion, the unity of these <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_7HKMBEK4TS00000000000000000000fs">four</span> elements of the marketing mix makes for a successful product.</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">As with any business, many aspects of our operations are subject to influences outside our control. We believe we have a strong brand portfolio with global reach and potential. As part of our strategy, we plan to continue to make investments in fast-growing markets and channels to grow market share.&#160;We discuss in greater detail risk factors relating to our business in Item <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_QL8HXS06DC00000000000000000000fs">1</span>A of this Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended <span id="fs_WBH0N2J8WW00000000000000000000FM">December 31, 2025</span>, and the reports that we file from time to time with the SEC.</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><br/></p>
<p style="font: 10pt / 1.2 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><b><i>European Based Operations</i></b></span></p>
<p style="font: 10pt / 1.2 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0px; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">We produce and distribute our fragrance products primarily under license agreements with brand owners, and fragrance product sales through our European based operations represented approximately 68% of net sales for the year ended December 31, 2025. We have built a portfolio of prestige brands, which include Boucheron, Coach, Jimmy Choo, Karl Lagerfeld, Kate Spade, Lacoste, Longchamp, Lanvin, Moncler, Montblanc, Off-White, <span style="color: #000000; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">Solf&#233;rino</span>&#160;and Van Cleef &amp; Arpels, whose products are distributed in over <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_OL2OBZTXXC00000000000000000000fs">120</span> countries around the world.&#160;</span><span style="font-size: 10.0pt;">In addition, in March 2025 Interparfums&#160;SA
acquired all intellectual property rights relating to&#160;Goutal&#160;Paris held
by Amorepacific&#160;Europe. Amorepacific&#160;Europe continued to operate the
Goutal&#160;brand under an existing license agreement that expired on December
31, 2025, and Interparfums&#160;SA began commercial use of the fragrance brand
on January 1, 2026.&#160;</span></span></p>
<p style="font: 10pt / 1.2 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font: 10pt / 1.2 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><b><i>United States Based Operations</i></b></span></p>
<p style="font: 10pt / 1.2 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0px; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">Prestige brand fragrance products are also produced and marketed through our United States based operations and represented approximately 32% of net sales for the year ended December 31, 2025. These fragrance products are sold under trademarks owned by us or pursuant to license or other agreements with the owners of brands, which include Abercrombie &amp; Fitch, Anna Sui, Donna Karan/DKNY, Emanuel Ungaro, Ferragamo, Graff, GUESS, Hollister, MCM, Oscar de la Renta, and Roberto Cavalli.</span></p>
<p style="font: 10pt / 1.2 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<div style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: 1.2;">
<div id="t_ft_O2XRTJ2NXS00000000000000000000b">
<table style="width: 100%; font-family: 'times new roman'; font-size: 10pt;">

<p style="font: 10pt / 1.2 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><b><i>Recent Developments</i></b></span></p>
<p style="font: 10pt / 1.2 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0px; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 10pt 36.5pt; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0pt; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-style: italic; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">Nautica</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0in; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 0.5in;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">In January 2026, we entered into a 20-year license
agreement for Nautica brand fragrances and fragrance related products, a
subsidiary of the Authentic Brands Group. This license will become effective on
the earlier of January 1, 2030 or the termination of the existing license agreement. Our rights under this license are subject to certain
minimum advertising expenditures and royalty payments as are customary in our
industry.<span style="mso-spacerun: yes;">&#160;</span></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0in; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 0.5in;"><br/></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 10pt 36.5pt; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0pt; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-style: italic; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">David Beckham</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0in; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 0.5in;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">In January 2026, we entered into a 20-year
license agreement for David Beckham brand fragrances and fragrance related
products, a subsidiary of the Authentic Brands Group. This license will become
effective on the earlier of April 1, 2028 or the termination of the existing
license agreement. Our rights under this
license are subject to certain minimum advertising expenditures and royalty
payments as are customary in our industry.&#160;</span></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0in; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 0.5in;"><br/></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 10pt 36.5pt; color: #000000; font: 10pt / 1.2 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-indent: 0pt; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-style: italic; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: #ffffff; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">GUESS</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0in; color: #000000; font: 10pt / 1.2 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-indent: 0.5in; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times; color: #000000; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: #ffffff;">In&#160;2018, GUESS?, Inc. and the Company&#160;signed an exclusive worldwide license agreement for the creation, the manufacturing and the distribution of fragrances under the GUESS&#160;brand until December 31, 2033. In December 2025, the license agreement was renewed for an additional&#160;15 years,&#160;extending the license through&#160;December 31, 2048.&#160;&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0in; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 0.5in;"><br/></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 10pt 36.5pt; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0pt; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-style: italic; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">Longchamp</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0in; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 0.5in;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">In July 2025, we announced that our 72% owned
French subsidiary, Interparfums SA, signed an exclusive license agreement with
Longchamp, a Parisian Maison, through December 31, 2036. Interparfums SA will
be responsible for the creation, development, production and distribution of
fragrance lines in Longchamp-brand points of sale and selective distribution
channels. The first launch is expected in 2027. Our
rights under this license are subject to certain minimum advertising
expenditures and royalty payments as are customary in our industry.&#160;</span></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0in; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 0.5in;"><br/></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 10pt 36.5pt; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0pt; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-style: italic; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">Goutal</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0in; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 0.5in;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">In March 2025, we announced that our 72% owned
French subsidiary, Interparfums SA, acquired all intellectual property rights
relating to Goutal Paris held by Amorepacific Europe. Amorepacific Europe
operated the Goutal brand under an existing license agreement that expired on
December 31, 2025, and Interparfums&#160;SA began commercial use of the
fragrance brand on January 1, 2026.</span></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0in; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 0.5in;"><br/></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 10pt 36.5pt; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0pt; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-style: italic; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">Coach</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0in; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 0.5in;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><b style="color: #000000; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><span style="color: #000000; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; line-height: inherit; display: inline !important;">In&#160;<span id="fs_PE1AFALR5C00000000000000000000fs">2015</span>, Coach&#160;and&#160;Interparfums&#160;SA signed an exclusive worldwide license agreement for the creation, the manufacturing and the distribution of fragrances under the Coach brand until June 30, 2026. In March 2025, the license agreement was renewed for an additional&#160;<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;">5-year</span>&#160;term, extending the license through&#160;June 30, 2031.&#160;&#160;</span></b></span></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0in; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 0.5in;"><br/></p>
<p style="color: #000000; font: 10pt / 1.2 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-indent: 0pt; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; margin: 0pt 0pt 10pt 36.5pt; text-align: justify;"><span><span style="font-style: italic; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: #ffffff; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><i>Abercrombie &amp; Fitch and Hollister</i></span></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0in; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 0.5in;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">In March 2025, we expanded our&#160;<span style="font-style: italic; line-height: inherit;">Fierce</span>&#160;distribution agreement, which now allows for a global distribution&#160;of the iconic&#160;Fierce&#160;fragrance line that either party may terminate on&#160;two year&#8217;s notice. Furthermore, our existing&#160;Abercrombie &amp; Fitch and Hollister fragrance license agreement will expire on&#160;March 14, 2028.&#160;The goal of the updated&#160;Fierce&#160;distribution agreement is to drive, over time, more consistency between the products that are carried in the Abercrombie &amp; Fitch stores and unaffiliated retailers.&#160;</span></span></p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 10pt 36.5pt; text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 0pt;"><span style="font-style: italic; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">Solf&#233;rino</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 0.5in;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">2025 marked the creation of Interparfums SA&#8217;s
first proprietary brand Solf&#233;rino, a collection of 10
niche&#160;fragrances developed by star perfumers and intended for the
collector&#8217;s fragrance market, and the opening of Interparfums SA&#8217;s first
boutique entirely dedicated to the brand at 310 Rue Saint-Honor&#233;, a legendary
address for Parisian luxury, along with an e-commerce site at https://solferino-paris.com/en.
The launch of this new brand reflects the Company&#8217;s medium-term growth strategy
in the extremely buoyant high-end fragrance market.&#160;The fragrance brand
was also launched initially through an ultra-selective distribution channel</span>


 &#160; &#160; &#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 10pt 36.5pt; text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 0pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="font-style: italic; font-size: 10pt;">Off-White</span></span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 0.5in;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">In December 2024, Interparfums SA signed for&#160;all Off-White<span style="line-height: inherit;">&#174;</span> brand names and registered trademarks for Class <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_Z1KDOSAOZK00000000000000000000fs">3</span> fragrance and cosmetic products, subject to an existing license that expired on <span style="border-right: none; border-left: none;">December 31, 2025</span>, when Interparfums SA began commercial use of the fragrance brands. Founded in <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_RYAFV2CPUO00000000000000000000fs">2012</span> by the late designer Virgil Abloh, Off-White is known for its high-end streetwear influences and bold approach to youth luxury. When Virgil Abloh founded Off-White, he sought to establish a <span style="font-size: 10pt;">brand with a universal design language that was artistic, disruptive and a reflection of concepts explored in the realm of youth culture</span></span><span style="font-size: 10pt;">.</span></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0px 0pt 0.5in; color: #000000; font: 10pt 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><br/></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0px 0pt 0.5in; color: #000000; font: 10pt 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-style: italic; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Van Cleef&#160;&amp; Arpels</span></span></p>
<div style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; border-left: none; border-right: none;">

<p style="margin: 10pt 0pt; color: #000000; font: 10pt / 1.2 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-indent: 36.5pt; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times; text-decoration: none; color: black;">In&#160;<span>2006</span>, Van Cleef &amp; Arpels and Interparfums SA signed a&#160;<span>12</span>-year worldwide license agreement to manufacture and distribute perfumes and related products under the Van Cleef &amp; Arpels brand name, which was subsequently extended for a further&#160;six years&#160;until December 31, 2024. <p style="margin: 10pt 0pt; text-indent: 36.5pt;"><span style="font-style: italic; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">Roberto Cavalli </span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 10pt 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.5pt; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">We entered into an exclusive worldwide fragrance license for the Roberto Cavalli brand, for <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_IGC9UTSREO00000000000000000000fs">6.5</span> years, effective July 6, 2023. Our Roberto Cavalli fragrance license is held and operated by our Italian subsidiary, Interparfums Italia, Srl, in keeping with the Company&#8217;s strategy to develop an Italian brand hub, and is managed out of Paris, France. Our rights under this license are subject to certain minimum advertising expenditures and royalty payments as are customary in our industry.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 10pt 0pt; text-indent: 36.5pt;"><span style="font-style: italic; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">Lacoste</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.5pt; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">In December 2022, we closed a transaction agreement with Lacoste, whereby an exclusive and worldwide license was granted to Interparfums SA for the production and distribution of Lacoste brand perfumes and cosmetics. Our rights under this license are subject to certain minimum advertising expenditures and royalty payments as are customary in our industry. The license became effective in January 2024 and will last for <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_9O5S36MI1S00000000000000000000fs">15</span> years.</span></p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">We are the owner of the Rochas brand, the Goutal&#160;brand, which was subject to an existing license that expired&#160;on December 31, 2025, the Lanvin brand name and trademark for our class of trade, Off-White, which was also subject to an existing license that expired on December 31, 2025, and the proprietary brand&#160;Solf&#233;rino, a <span style="line-height: inherit;">collection of niche fragrances which we launched in 2025. </span>In addition, we have built a portfolio of licensed prestige brands whereby we produce and distribute our prestige fragrance products under license agreements with brand owners. Under license agreements, we obtain the right to use the brand name, create new fragrances and packaging, determine positioning and distribution, and market and sell the licensed products, in exchange for the payment of royalties. Our rights under license agreements are also generally subject to certain minimum sales requirements and advertising expenditures as are customary in our industry.</span></p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="line-height: inherit;">In connection with the acquisition of the Lanvin brand names and trademarks for our class of trade, we granted the seller the right to repurchase the brand names and trademarks on July 1, 2027 for &#8364;<span id="fs_UY43G5SZN400000000000000000000fs">70</span> million (approximately $82 million) in accordance with an amendment signed in <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_56WA8UN6OG00000000000000000000fs">2021</span>. In connection with such amendment, we also granted a license to the seller to develop and sell cosmetics other than fragrances.</span></span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><br/></p>
<p style="font: 10pt / 1.2 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><i>Fragrance Portfolio</i>&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font: 10pt / 1.2 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0px; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><i><span style="line-height: inherit;">Abercrombie &amp; Fitch</span></i><b><span style="line-height: inherit;">&#8212; </span></b><span style="line-height: inherit;">In <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_QMOBCJMLUO00000000000000000000fs">2014</span>, we entered into a worldwide license to create, produce and distribute new fragrances and fragrance related products under the Abercrombie &amp; Fitch brand name. We distribute these fragrances in specialty stores, department stores and duty free shops. Our initial men&#8217;s scent, <i>First Instinct,</i> was launched in <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_0BMBU9KT6O00000000000000000000fs">2016</span> followed by a women&#8217;s version in <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_HT1T2HYP3K00000000000000000000fs">2017</span>. Since that time, we unveiled several new fragrances, most notably the <i>Authentic </i>and <i>Away </i>duos as well as brand extensions.</span></span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">Abercrombie &amp; Fitch Co. is a leading, global, omnichannel specialty retailer of apparel and accessories for men, women and kids. The iconic Abercrombie &amp; Fitch brand was born in <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_C95J767NO000000000000000000000fs">1892</span> and aims to make every day feel as exceptional as the start of a long weekend.</span></p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">In <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_SGANLQ3KF400000000000000000000fs">2023</span>, we announced our agreement to distribute Abercrombie &amp; Fitch&#8217;s number <span id="fs_5IP1GA39Q800000000000000000000fs">one</span> men's fragrance, <i>Fierce,</i> in selected markets. The first phase of the agreement, which became effective on September 1, 2023, covers <i>Fierce</i> distribution in certain major markets, including Europe, Mexico and Australia. The second phase, which was activated in February 2024, covers distribution in additional markets in Western Europe and Latin America. Later in <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_1T8G5LE4TC00000000000000000000fs">2024</span>, we began distributing&#160;<i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;">Fierce Pride.</i>&#160;I<span style="font-size: 10pt;">n March 2025, we
expanded our&#160;Fierce&#160;distribution agreement to allow for a
global distribution&#160;of the iconic&#160;Fierce&#160;fragrance line
that either party may terminate on&#160;two year&#8217;s notice. Furthermore, our
</span></span>existing&#160;Abercrombie &amp; Fitch and Hollister fragrance license agreement
will expire on&#160;March 14, 2028.&#160;The goal of the<span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;"> updated&#160;Fierce&#160;distribution
agreement is to drive, over time, more consistency between the products that
are carried in the Abercrombie &amp; Fitch stores and unaffiliated retailers. In&#160;2025, we introduced a new&#160;fragrance duo, </span><span style="font-size: 10pt;">100% Passion</span><span style="font-size: 10pt;">, and the </span><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Fierce Reserve</span><span style="font-size: 10pt;"> extension.</span></span></span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><i><span style="line-height: inherit;">Anna Sui</span></i><b><span style="line-height: inherit;">&#8212;&#160;</span></b><span style="line-height: inherit;">In <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_DKIM8JXPUO00000000000000000000fs">2011</span>, we entered into an exclusive worldwide fragrance license to create, produce and distribute fragrances and fragrance related products under the Anna Sui brand. The Anna Sui brand is mostly popular in Asia.&#160;Over the past decade, we have worked in partnership with Anna Sui and her creative team to build upon the brand&#8217;s customer appeal and develop and market a family of fragrances including <i>Fantasia</i>, <i>Sui Dreams</i>, <i>Sky,</i> and <i>Sundae</i>. In <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_IQV69H842800000000000000000000fs">2024</span>, we introduced a new flanker within the <span style="font-style: italic;">Fantasia</span> fragrance family and launched <span style="font-style: italic; line-height: inherit;">Wild Wonder</span>, a new <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_4PQEWPFKI800000000000000000000fs">four</span>-scent fragrance collection. In 2025, we introduced <span style="font-style: italic;">Sundae Neon Twist</span>, the newest scent within the <span style="font-style: italic;">Sundae</span> fragrance family.&#160;</span></span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><i><span style="line-height: inherit;">Boucheron</span></i><b><span style="line-height: inherit;">&#8212; </span></b><span style="line-height: inherit;">In <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_NFDGT7ASHS00000000000000000000fs">2010</span>, we entered into an exclusive <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_RFWTX47YB400000000000000000000fs">15</span>-year worldwide license agreement for the creation, development and distribution of fragrances and fragrance related products under the Boucheron brand, which was extended until December 31, 2027 for its main lines. For over a century, since becoming the first jeweler to open a boutique on Place Vend&#244;me in <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_79JVNSZMWG00000000000000000000fs">1893</span>, Boucheron has embodied very high-end creation, luxury and French know-how. The mysterious and seductive collection of Boucheron fragrances unquestionably continues this prestigious line of creations.</span></span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><br/></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">Boucheron&#8217;s legacy scents, <i>Femme</i> and <i>Homme</i>, and the legendary <i>Jaipur</i> perfume form the foundation of brand sales.&#160;Our team has enriched the portfolio with <i>Quatre</i> for men and women, a new men&#8217;s fragrance, <i>Singulier,</i> along with several special editions, a growing collection of unique scents aptly named, <i>La Collection</i>, and <i>Serpent Boh&#232;me. </i>Boucheron operates through several boutiques worldwide as well as an e-commerce site.</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><i><span style="line-height: inherit;">Coach</span></i><span style="line-height: inherit;">&#8212; In <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_N56FVPN29S00000000000000000000fs">2015</span>, we entered into an exclusive <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_G59DI80UO000000000000000000000fs">11</span>-year worldwide license to create, produce and distribute men&#8217;s and women&#8217;s fragrances and fragrance related products under the Coach brand name. We distribute these fragrances globally to department stores, specialty stores and duty free shops, as well as in Coach retail stores.</span></span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><br/></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">Founded in <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_G70NN9ODFK00000000000000000000fs">1941</span>, Coach is the ultimate American leather goods brand and has always been renowned for its quality craftsmanship.&#160;Now the luxury brand that best embodies New York&#8217;s casual elegance, Coach also offers collections of ready-to-wear, lifestyle accessories and fragrances. Its contemporary approach to luxury combines authenticity and innovation, exported worldwide thanks to its thoroughly American non-conformist vision.</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="line-height: inherit;">In <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_PMYX584G3400000000000000000000fs">2016</span>,&#160;<span style="font-size: 10pt;">we launched our first Coach fragrance, a women&#8217;s
signature scent, and in 2017, a men&#8217;s scent, both of which became and remain
top selling prestige fragrances, leading the brand to become the second largest
in our portfolio. Subsequent extensions have magnified the Coach fragrance
enterprise as have entirely new collections, including <i>Coach Dreams</i>
which debuted in early 2020, <span style="color: #000000;">and its </span><span style="mso-bidi-font-style: italic;">sister scents,&#160;</span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;">Dreams Sunset </i><span style="mso-bidi-font-style: italic;">and </span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;">Dreams Moonlight</i><span style="mso-bidi-font-style: italic;">, as well as Coach&#160;</span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;">Wild Rose</i><span style="mso-bidi-font-style: italic;"> and Coach&#160;</span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;">Open Road</i><span style="mso-bidi-font-style: italic;">. In&#160;2025 we further enriched the men&#8217;s
and women&#8217;s lines with two new fragrances: </span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;">Coach</i> <i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;">Eau De Parfum</i><span style="mso-bidi-font-style: italic;"> for men which featured NBA superstar Jayson Tatum as the new face of
Coach fragrances, and </span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;">Coach Gold</i><span style="mso-bidi-font-style: italic;"> for women which starred actress Storm Reid
as brand ambassador. We have plans to launch new extensions in 2026. Coach is
part of the Tapestry house of brands.</span></span>


</span></span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><i><span style="line-height: inherit;"><span style="color: #000000; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: italic; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 48px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">David</span></span></i> <span style="line-height: inherit;"><span style="color: #000000; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 48px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">Beckham -<span style="font-weight: bold;">&#160;</span></span></span></span><span style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000;">In January 2026 we entered into an
exclusive, 20-year worldwide license agreement with David Beckham for the
creation, development, production, and distribution of fragrances under the
David Beckham brand.</span> <span style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000;">This
agreement further strengthens our relationship with Authentic Brands Group
(&#8220;Authentic&#8221;), the company who co-owns and manages the David Beckham
brand. Together, we will blend Beckham&#8217;s entrepreneurial influence with our
fragrance expertise to inspire a richer world of style and self-expression
through scent. Guided by our dedication
to quality, innovation, and craftsmanship, we will strengthen the global
presence of Beckham&#8217;s existing fragrance lines and plan to unveil a new
signature fragrance by the end of 2029. </span></span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span><i><span style="line-height: inherit;">Donna Karan/DKNY</span></i></span><b><span style="line-height: inherit;">&#8212; </span></b><span style="line-height: inherit;">In September 2021, we entered into a long-term global licensing agreement for the creation, development and distribution of fragrances and fragrance related products under the Donna Karan and DKNY brands, which took effect on July 1, 2022.</span></span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">The Donna Karan and DKNY brands, which draw from the energy and attitude of New York City, are powerhouses in fashion and fragrance. These global lifestyle brands have been excellent additions to our portfolio. With this agreement, we have gained several well-established and valuable fragrance franchises.</span></p>

<td class="pgno" style="padding: 0px; text-align: center; box-shadow: none;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times;" class="pageno"><span id="PageBreakNo9" class="pageno">9</span></span></td>

<div class="pageBreak" style="page-break-before: always;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><a href="#TOC"></a></span><br/></div>






































</div>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0px; font: 10pt 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; text-align: left;"><br/></p>






































</div>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">Jimmy Choo encompasses a complete luxury accessories brand. Women&#8217;s shoes remain the core of the product offering, alongside handbags, small leather goods, scarves, eyewear, belts, fragrances and men&#8217;s shoes. Jimmy Choo has a global store network encompassing more than <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_W2ZJA54Q1S00000000000000000000fs">200</span> stores and is present in the most prestigious department and specialty stores worldwide. Jimmy Choo is part of the Capri Holdings luxury fashion group.&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Jimmy&#160;</span><span style="font-size: 10.0pt;">Choo has grown to become our largest brand with new pillars and extensions debuting regularly, both for men and women.&#160;Established fragrance collections, including <i>Jimmy Choo</i>, <i>Jimmy Choo Man,</i> and <i>Jimmy Choo I Want Choo</i> continue </span><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: Tahoma;">to see international success. </span><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: Tahoma; mso-fareast-language: ZH-CN; mso-bidi-language: HI; mso-bidi-font-style: italic;">In&#160;2025 we further elevated both men&#8217;s and women&#8217;s lines with two new extensions: </span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;"><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: Tahoma; mso-fareast-language: ZH-CN; mso-bidi-language: HI;">Jimmy Choo Man Extreme</span></i><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: Tahoma; mso-fareast-language: ZH-CN; mso-bidi-language: HI; mso-bidi-font-style: italic;"> and </span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;"><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: Tahoma; mso-fareast-language: ZH-CN; mso-bidi-language: HI;">Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love</span></i><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: Tahoma; mso-fareast-language: ZH-CN; mso-bidi-language: HI; mso-bidi-font-style: italic;">. In 2026 we are set to roll out new extensions to advance the ongoing growth of the brand.</span><span style="font-size: 10.0pt;">&#160;</span></span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><i><span style="line-height: inherit;">Karl Lagerfeld</span></i><b><span style="line-height: inherit;">&#8212; </span></b><span style="line-height: inherit;">In <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_1S5H2OHSN400000000000000000000fs">2012</span>, we entered into a <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_DQ0YKH3S9S00000000000000000000fs">20</span>-year worldwide license agreement with Karl Lagerfeld B.V., the internationally renowned haute couture fashion house, to create, produce and distribute fragrances under the Karl Lagerfeld brand.</span></span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">Under the creative direction of the late Karl Lagerfeld, <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_Q78XEILIZ400000000000000000000fs">one</span> of the world&#8217;s most influential and iconic designers, the Lagerfeld Portfolio represents a modern approach to distribution, an innovative digital strategy and a global <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_DFTHRAXU7400000000000000000000fs">360</span> degree vision that reflect the designer&#8217;s own style and soul. Karl Lagerfeld created the first fragrance that bears his name in <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_0I4X9ZLDUO00000000000000000000fs">1978</span>, and that legacy has expanded to include several growing multi-scent collections, <i>Les Parfums Mati&#232;res, </i>and more recently, <i>Karl Cities, </i>a new collection featuring entries for New York,&#160;Paris, Hamburg, Tokyo&#160;and Vienna was unveiled. </span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><br/></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Since </span><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: Tahoma; mso-fareast-language: ZH-CN; mso-bidi-language: HI; mso-bidi-font-style: italic;">joining our portfolio, we have expanded the legacy fragrance families with new extensions, and have also launched the blockbuster fragrance </span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;"><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: Tahoma; mso-fareast-language: ZH-CN; mso-bidi-language: HI;">Rouge</span></i><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: Tahoma; mso-fareast-language: ZH-CN; mso-bidi-language: HI; mso-bidi-font-style: italic;"> as well as </span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;"><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: Tahoma; mso-fareast-language: ZH-CN; mso-bidi-language: HI;">Ikonik</span></i><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: Tahoma; mso-fareast-language: ZH-CN; mso-bidi-language: HI; mso-bidi-font-style: italic;">, with its bottle design inspired by the late Karl Lagerfeld himself. In&#160;2025&#160;we launched two separate dual gender duos: Karl Lagerfeld</span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;"><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: Tahoma; mso-fareast-language: ZH-CN; mso-bidi-language: HI;"> Jeans Urban Pink</span></i><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: Tahoma; mso-fareast-language: ZH-CN; mso-bidi-language: HI; mso-bidi-font-style: italic;"> and </span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;"><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: Tahoma; mso-fareast-language: ZH-CN; mso-bidi-language: HI;">Urban Blue</span></i><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: Tahoma; mso-fareast-language: ZH-CN; mso-bidi-language: HI; mso-bidi-font-style: italic;">, and the two newest scents within the<span style="mso-spacerun: yes;">&#160; </span></span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;"><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: Tahoma; mso-fareast-language: ZH-CN; mso-bidi-language: HI;">Les Parfums Mati&#232;res</span></i><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: Tahoma; mso-fareast-language: ZH-CN; mso-bidi-language: HI; mso-bidi-font-style: italic;"> family, </span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;"><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: Tahoma; mso-fareast-language: ZH-CN; mso-bidi-language: HI;">Bois De Santal and Fleur d&#8217;Iris</span></i><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: Tahoma; mso-fareast-language: ZH-CN; mso-bidi-language: HI; mso-bidi-font-style: italic;">. In 2026 we plan to launch two new fragrance duos for existing fragrance lines.</span></span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><br/></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><i><span style="line-height: inherit;">Kate Spade</span></i><b><span style="line-height: inherit;">&#8212; </span></b><span style="line-height: inherit;">In <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_NWSTU7UW1S00000000000000000000fs">2019</span>, we entered into an exclusive, <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_M6QW2PNFE800000000000000000000fs">11</span>-year worldwide license agreement with Kate Spade to create, produce and distribute new perfumes and fragrance related products under the Kate Spade brand which we distribute globally to department and specialty stores and duty free shops, as well as in Kate Spade retail stores.</span></span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">Since its launch in <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_IFBWM9VGWG00000000000000000000fs">1993</span> with a collection of <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_7WKCXAX2LS00000000000000000000fs">six</span> essential handbags, Kate Spade has always stood for optimistic femininity. Today, the brand is a global life and style house with handbags, ready-to-wear, jewelry, footwear, gifts, home d&#233;cor and more. Polished ease, thoughtful details and a modern, sophisticated use of color&#8212;Kate Spade&#8217;s founding principles define a unique style synonymous with joy. Under the vision of its creative director, the brand continues to celebrate confident women with a youthful spirit. Kate Spade is part of the Tapestry house of brands.</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">Our&#160;<span style="font-size: 10pt;">first original scent, <i>Kate Spade New York</i>, debuted in January 2021. We have continued to enrich the collection with extensions, including&#160;<i>Kate Spade Sparkle,&#160;</i><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;">Kate Spade Cherie,</i><span style="mso-bidi-font-style: italic;"> as well as two new fragrances in 2025 &#8722; </span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;">Ch&#233;rie Je T&#8217;aime and Kate Spade New York Pop</i><span style="mso-bidi-font-style: italic;">.</span></span>&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><i><span style="line-height: inherit;">Lacoste </span></i><b><span style="line-height: inherit;">&#8211; </span></b><span style="line-height: inherit;">In December 2022, we closed a transaction agreement with Lacoste, whereby a 15-year exclusive and worldwide license was granted for the production and distribution of Lacoste brand perfumes and cosmetics.</span></span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">At the juncture of sport and fashion, Lacoste frees us up, creates movement in our lives, and liberates our self-expression. In every collection, in every line, Lacoste&#8217;s timeless elegance is captured through a combination of the creative and the classic. Since its beginnings, the crocodile&#8217;s aura has grown more powerful with every generation who has worn it, becoming a rallying sign beyond style. Passed from country to country, from <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_38BSG3UW2O00000000000000000000fs">one</span> generation to the next, from <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_0YKLOQ640G00000000000000000000fs">one</span> friend to another, Lacoste pieces become imbued with an emotional connection that raises them to the status of icons.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0px; font: 10pt 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; text-align: left;"><br/></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0px; font: 10pt 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; text-align: left;"><br/></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">The <span style="font-size: 10pt;">Lacoste license took effect in January 2024, and we developed go-forward strategies, curated the collection, and produced entirely new fresh goods during the year. In 2024, we recreated <i>Lacoste Original</i>, the brand&#8217;s first men&#8217;s line and introduced the <i>L.12.12</i> fragrance line.&#160;<span style="mso-bidi-font-style: italic;">In&#160;2025, we enriched&#160;the </span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;">Original</i><span style="mso-bidi-font-style: italic;"> line with a new men&#8217;s fragrance, </span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;">Original Parfum</i><span style="mso-bidi-font-style: italic;">, and the line&#8217;s first women&#8217;s fragrance, </span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;">Original Femme</i><span style="mso-bidi-font-style: italic;">. We also launched a new </span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;">L.12.12</i><span style="mso-bidi-font-style: italic;"> dual gender duo, </span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;">Silver Rose</i><span style="mso-bidi-font-style: italic;"> and </span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;">Silver</i> <i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;">Grey</i><span style="mso-bidi-font-style: italic;">. In 2026, we will further expand the Lacoste fragrance lines with additional extensions, leveraging the strong foundation we&#8217;ve built in our first two years overseeing the brand. Sales of Lacoste fragrances exceeded our internal estimates and passed the $100 million in 2025</span>.</span>&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><i><span style="line-height: inherit;">Lanvin</span></i><b><span style="line-height: inherit;">&#8212; </span></b><span style="line-height: inherit;">In <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_K9U3XUWWQO00000000000000000000fs">2007</span>, we acquired the worldwide rights to the Lanvin brand names and international trademarks listed in Class <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_W74BTGUW7K00000000000000000000fs">3</span>, our class of trade. A synonym of luxury and elegance, the Lanvin fashion house, founded in <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_OHE9QZ203K00000000000000000000fs">1889</span> by Jeanne Lanvin, expanded into fragrances in the <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_PT8NGQ22Y800000000000000000000fs">1920</span>s.</span></span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="line-height: inherit;"><br/></span></span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="line-height: inherit;">Lanvin fragrances occupy an important position in the selective distribution market in France, Eastern Europe and Asia, and we have several lines currently in distribution, including <i>&#201;clat d&#8217;Arp&#232;ge</i>, <i>Lanvin L&#8217;Homme</i>, <i>Jeanne Lanvin, Modern Princess, A Girl in Capri, </i>and <i>Les Fleurs de Lanvin.</i></span>&#160;Two new initiatives are planned in late 2026 and early 2028.&#160;</span></p>
<p style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; line-height: 12pt; margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0in; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 12pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><i><span style="font-size: 10.0pt;">Longchamp</span></i><b><span style="font-size: 10.0pt;">&#8212;</span></b><span style="font-size: 10.0pt;">In July 2025, we signed an exclusive license agreement with Longchamp, through December 31, 2036. Interparfums SA will be responsible for the creation, development, production and distribution of fragrance lines in Longchamp-brand points of sale and selective distribution channels.</span><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: Tahoma; mso-fareast-language: ZH-CN; mso-bidi-language: HI; mso-bidi-font-style: italic;"> Our rights under this license are subject to certain minimum advertising expenditures and royalty payments as are customary in our industry.</span></span></p>
<p style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; line-height: 12pt; margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; line-height: 12pt; margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">Longchamp is a French luxury brand founded in 1948, renowned for its craftsmanship, authenticity, and modern creativity. Family-owned, the Maison blends heritage savoir&#8209;faire with innovation, offering leather goods, accessories, and ready&#8209;to&#8209;wear designed for active, elegant lifestyles. Longchamp values sustainability, durability, and timeless design. Its distribution combines a strong global retail network of boutiques, a selective wholesale presence, and a robust e&#8209;commerce platform, ensuring both exclusivity and accessibility worldwide.</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><i><span style="line-height: inherit;">MCM</span></i><b><span style="line-height: inherit;">&#8212; </span></b><span style="line-height: inherit;">In <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_9ZL7XKQB5S00000000000000000000fs">2019</span>, we entered into an exclusive, <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_35XCHISYF400000000000000000000fs">10</span>-year worldwide license agreement with German luxury fashion house MCM for the creation, development and distribution of fragrances and fragrance related products under the MCM brand.&#160;The agreement has a <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_GAOZZLCNK000000000000000000000fs">4</span>-year automatic renewal option, potentially extending the license until December 31, 2034.</span></span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">MCM is a luxury lifestyle goods and fashion house founded in <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_7WID999KIO00000000000000000000fs">1976</span> with an attitude defined by the cultural Zeitgeist and its German heritage with a focus on functional innovation, including the use of cutting-edge techniques. Today, through its association with music, art, travel and technology, MCM embodies the bold, rebellious and aspirational. Always with an eye on the disruptive, the driving force behind MCM centers on revolutionizing classic design with futuristic materials. MCM&#8217;s millennial and Gen Z audience is genderless, ageless, empowered and unconstrained by rules and boundaries.</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">Following <span style="font-size: 10pt;">through on our plan to develop extraordinary fragrances that capture the creative spirit of MCM, our first new fragrance, <i>MCM</i>, was released in&#160;2021. In 2023, we debuted our first ever men&#8217;s scent, MCM<i> Onyx</i>, </span><span style="font-size: 10pt;">inspired by the brands beloved bags and later enriched the fragrance line with </span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">MCM&#160;Crush</span></i><span style="font-size: 10pt;">, </span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">MCM&#160;Diamonds</span></i><span style="font-size: 10pt;">, and the limited addition MCM fragrance encrusted with Swarovski crystals. In&#160;2025 we launched a brand new six-scent collection, </span><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">MCM Collection</span></i><span style="font-size: 10pt;">, inspired by the brands iconic animals. In 2026, we&#8217;ll debut new extensions designed to energize and expand the brand.</span>&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin: 0px; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><br/></p>
